public_freeze_rule: The commit containing this protocol and the exact audit-code hash must be publicly pushed before the audit is executed.

endpoints.regimes: high and low by the training-period median reconstructed log-variance signal

requirements: return composite ratio below 1.0 at both 50 and 100 paths
return energy ratio below 1.0 at both 50 and 100 paths
paired-origin one-sided energy p-value below 0.10 at 100 paths
at least four of five 20-path repeat composites below 1.0
candidate return composite below the unconditional full-vector comparator at 100 paths
direct covariance Frobenius error ratio no greater than 1.05 at 100 paths
random-portfolio variance error ratio no greater than 1.05 at 100 paths
5% VaR pinball ratio no greater than 1.05 at 100 paths
neither high- nor low-volatility regime return composite ratio exceeds 1.02 at 100 paths

decision_rule: If and only if every survival requirement passes, retain k=32 for a newly preregistered untouched-market evaluation. Failure leaves it exploratory and forbids external promotion under this route.
